description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes used in the notes management system, specifically for creating, updating, and responding with note data.

classes.name: NoteCreateRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new note, requiring a title and content with validation rules.

classes.name: NoteUpdateRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing note, requiring a title and content with validation rules.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: DTO for returning note data, including ID, title, content, and timestamps.
